# b1dz

> b1dz is an AI-powered crypto arbitrage terminal for realtime auto-trading across multiple centralized and decentralized exchanges. It finds price gaps and executes trades automatically using a deterministic analysis engine.

b1dz connects to centralized exchanges (Kraken, Coinbase, Binance.US, Gemini) and DEXes (Uniswap V3, 0x, Jupiter, Pump.fun, with more coming soon) over persistent WebSocket feeds. A deterministic analysis engine (EMA, RSI, MACD, ATR, VWAP, volume checks, and market-regime classification) scores setups before execution. Signal-only plugins mean plugin authors never touch your exchange keys.

## Product

- [Home](https://b1dz.com/): AI Arbitrage Terminal overview, features, strategies, and supported exchanges.
- [Plugin Store](https://b1dz.com/store): DEX connectors and trading strategies. Authoring SDK opening soon.
- [Sign up](https://b1dz.com/signup): Create an account and start trading.
- [Sign in](https://b1dz.com/login): Log in to the dashboard and console.

## Features

- Realtime Multi-Exchange Data: Persistent WebSocket feeds for prices, balances, spreads, and activity logs.
- Deterministic Analysis Engine: Indicator- and regime-based scoring before any execution.
- Spread Arbitrage and Inventory Arbitrage: Separate cross-exchange and inventory-aware paths.
- Backtesting + Analytics: Validate strategies against historical data.
- OHLC Charts + Trade Context: Candlestick charts with the context behind each trade.
- Risk Controls: Trailing stops and position limits (one position per exchange).

## Trading strategies

- Trend Continuation, Mean Reversion, Breakout/Breakdown (directional, deterministic setup scoring).
- Spread Arbitrage and Inventory Arbitrage (cross-exchange and inventory-aware).
- Legacy Multi-Signal Fallback (composite heuristics as a fallback path).
